purpose: External scorer-family validation of frozen GL-LIU v1 vs unified core-five DUFS-LIU on ProcessBench, using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the teacher-forcing scorer (all 8 existing cells used Qwen3-4B/8B only)

frozen_roster.no_selection_on_new_cells: control and candidate names are read from the artifacts above, never recomputed from the Llama cells' own labels; DEV = {(qwen3_4b, gsm8k), (qwen3_4b, math)} does not move

named_competitors.paper: Chen, Chen, Yue, Li — ICML 2026, PMLR 306
named_competitors.dataset_subset: same 4 ProcessBench subsets (GSM8K, MATH, OlympiadBench, Omni-MATH), Qwen3-4B/8B only — NOT run on Llama-3.1-8B
named_competitors.protocol: teacher-forced single forward pass, Shannon-entropy Drop score, SLA metric (own reported numbers only; also reproduced in-repo under our F1 protocol at scripts/gl_liu_v1/localization/evidence_drop.py)
named_competitors.comparison_level: 3 (same dataset only) — quoted from the paper / our existing Qwen3 reproduction, not rerun on Llama

named_competitors.dataset_subset: ProcessBench first-error localization (subset/model TBD by /paper-digest audit)
named_competitors.protocol: next-token-probability-based unsupervised scoring, batch-joint candidate evaluation
named_competitors.supervision_access_sampling: unsupervised, gray-box (next-token probabilities), reported as label-free
named_competitors.comparison_level: 3 (same dataset only) — quoted, not rerun; first published label-free peer to audit per docs/research_notes/reasoning_localization_methods_and_benchmarks_2026.md

mandatory_competitor_gate.comparison_level_definition: 1=same exact outputs, 2=same protocol/new sampling, 3=same dataset only (docs/research_notes/external_data_collection_plan_2026.md)

protocol.conditioning: no /no_think suffix (Qwen3-specific switch, meaningless for Llama) -- pass --prompt-suffix ""
protocol.prompt: data_loaders.math_prompt on the problem (our pre-registered choice, same as the Qwen3 cells)
protocol.decoding: teacher-forced greedy single forward pass over the GIVEN reasoning chain -- nothing is generated

gate_b.requires: a GENERATED greedy Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct cell (gen_token_ids + token_entropies saved), no prompt_suffix

sequence: 3. Gate B: submit_teacher_forced.sbatch --model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --validate --validate-pkl <gateb raw pkl> --validate-dataset gsm8k --validate-prompt-suffix "" --validate-n 20
4. N=30 pilot: --n-samples 30 --prompt-suffix "" --out .../pb_llama31_8b_pilot; gate on n_rows_misaligned==0, n_unmapped_steps==0
6. fetch to dataset_cache/repgrid/pb_llama31_8b/, validate with load_rows(), then scripts/gl_liu_external_v1/run.py

label_policy.threshold_calibration: labels in calibration half only, 100 repeated splits
label_policy.tuning: none -- frozen v1 selection carried unchanged; only the token_feature_views reconstruction (Step 236) was independently reproduction-tested against the 8 Qwen3 cells before being trusted on new data
